provenance.note: Dev vignette for slice 0009. Never scored. The drafter had read the 17 confidently wrong findings from labels in the twelve scored conversations outside the least-seen three, and writes the agent's fixes too. Classes: self-correction L20 (its correction arrives in the reply to the clinical L21); does-not-apply L49 (the criterion names men; she is a woman; the only criterion for one sex in this study, and it failed in the twelve, so reuse is unavoidable); polarity L72 (an exclusion that holds) and L71 (one that does not). Controls: L22 (a firm agreement to contraception, on a label where a hedged one failed in the twelve); L55 (a plain denial); L67 and L68 (plain denials of pregnancy and breastfeeding); L70 (a general denial that plainly covers the criterion). L59 and L63 failed in the twelve; they are answered plainly and test no class.
